name: ASUS Aura mousemats (ROG Balteus)
description: Per-LED lighting (15 LEDs) of the ASUS ROG Balteus and Balteus Qi mousemats. Adapted from OpenRGB's AsusAuraMousematController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command and hardware effects are never sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/asus-aura-mousemat.md.
